answer: Because the timing is written down against the nectar challenge, the yarrow audit can replay the wander history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 145 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2141 identities would post 2296 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
